name: Hitozuma Isekai Senshi Natsumi
original_name: 人妻異世界戦士ナツミ
source:
Natsumi Takahata was just an ordinary housewife until the day she was overwhelmed 
by a suddenly appeared ball of light and summoned into the alternate world.
According to a god of the world who summoned Natsumi, the world is currently 
facing the risk of collapse due to the demon lord who also came inter-worldly.
Nothing but Natsumi's sword has a chance to defeat the demon lord.
In order to get back to her original world, she takes the sword in her hands.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE224902.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
高畑夏美原本只是一名普通的家庭主妇，直到有一天她不知所措 
被突然出现的光球召唤到异世界。
据召唤夏美的世界之神所说，目前的世界 
面临着因同样来到异界的魔王而崩溃的危险。
只有夏美的剑才有机会打败魔王。
为了回到原来的世界，她拿起了手中的剑。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE224902.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
